panels.title: Goad application map
panels.description: Green is up and red is down. Line color is the protocol. Hover a box for the live check. The flow graph lists every call.

panels.title: Live flows
panels.description: Hover a node for cluster, namespace, node, IP, endpoint, version, and health. A flow is up only when both ends are up.

options.content:
Box color is the live probe. Green is up, red is down. A line on the map is the protocol, not the health. A row in the flow table is up only when both ends are up.

Hover a node in Live flows for cluster, namespace, node, IP, endpoint, version, and health.

CLM has no URL in this org, so it stays down. Shop users at 10.47.7.75 does not answer. The four diagnostic agents on this cluster are scaled to 0; the live agents are the Tanzu CF apps. Music-store host color is the Ready condition. AgentMinder host color is the kubelet port, because this Prometheus does not scrape that cluster. The node label on an app is the placement when this board was built. The pod table is the live placement.
